origin: Explicit engineering defaults selected for the delegated baseline; NOT measured results. Changes require a reviewed requirement delta, never automatic loosening after failure.

targets.criterion: Zero wrong-course writes, conflicting overwrite acceptance, duplicate accepted learner attempts, or fabricated completion in the complete adversarial test set.
targets.measurement: Fixture/property tests + real owner integration. Zero observed failures is not a universal proof.

targets.criterion: 100% of the frozen release inventory has a valid source disposition; no recoverable present material left unprocessed at full release. Every applicable slide link is reviewed or explicitly unresolved with evidence; nonrecoverable missing originals remain visible.
targets.measurement: Freeze current inventory at acceptance; retain 37 reported units as history not a permanent hard-coded denominator. Report counts for each status. Unresolved recoverable linking prevents full completion without explicit scope decision.

targets.criterion: No known incorrect reviewed link. Manual correction must persist across every regeneration and source revision scenario.
targets.measurement: Reviewed held-out cases from every configured course plus replay checks; correctness evaluated separately from volume.

targets.criterion: At least 95% precision among proposed high-confidence links on at least 100 adjudicated cases spanning all five courses, including skips/repeats; report coverage and a binomial confidence interval. Suggestions remain suggestions.
targets.measurement: Held-out sources; unseen repeated/partial transcript cases; failures do not lower the target automatically or justify marking suggested links confirmed.

targets.criterion: On unambiguous labeled spans, p95 absolute boundary error <= 2 seconds; player seek lands within 0.5 seconds after seeked on supported media, tested separately from link accuracy.
targets.measurement: Real source labels/codec/device tests; compressed media timing exceptions are documented, not relabeled exact.

targets.criterion: Local loaded-state interactions p95 <= 150 ms; local durable-submit acknowledgment p95 <= 500 ms after storage commit; source warm navigation p95 <= 1 s.
targets.measurement: 100 repetitions on documented reference PC/browser. Network upload, Drive sync and AI completion measured separately, no fabricated end-to-end SLA.

targets.criterion: Once full valid bytes are readable locally, admission within two configured scan periods when not resource-blocked. Queued native wait, provider time and output sync are separately visible.
targets.measurement: Deterministic clock fixtures then actual Drive/PC observations; scans default 5 s active/15 s idle.

targets.criterion: No known critical false grading, answer leakage or unsupported diagnosis in the release set. Target >=95% reviewer agreement on observable criteria, <=5% false rejection of valid alternatives, and explicit uncertainty on ambiguous/recognition cases.
targets.measurement: At least 100 held-out judgments spanning all courses and task types; report denominators/CI, assistance and reviewed-label disagreements. Human/model consensus alone is not ground truth.

targets.criterion: Quick-answer exchanges create no new performance record; unobserved is never failure. No learned/retention/transfer percentage claim without its own evaluated evidence.
targets.measurement: Record/output tests and representative real tutoring; later unaided performance is observed separately, not required to prove a fake guaranteed improvement.

targets.criterion: All relevant 24 global UI cases pass in both themes, with keyboard, focus, 200% text, narrow reflow, reduced motion and actual chosen devices. Original scientific colors unchanged.
targets.measurement: Playwright and axe-core plus manual keyboard/screen-reader checks; automated zero findings is not WCAG certification.

targets.criterion: Every submitted input acknowledged by Brain remains recoverable after injected interruption; uncertain native completion reconciles before retry; no loss from failed view generation.
targets.measurement: Fault injection and actual same-user restart/reconnect/backup tests. Device-only draft is labeled with browser-storage limits.

targets.criterion: No unapproved separately billed calls or public PC endpoint. One native turn and one background processing unit by default; no model calls while idle.
targets.measurement: Admission/config tests plus usage/log review. Existing subscription allowance and current measured cost remain external facts, not inferred from local counters.

targets.criterion: Support current stable Windows Edge/Chrome plus mobile Safari and Chrome UI; exact versions recorded at acceptance. Tablet/narrow layouts share actions.
targets.measurement: Run actual available target hardware sessions; mark missing platform evidence BLOCKED for that platform, not globally verified via viewport emulation.
